## Problem and behavior

Describe the protected product action, provider version and behavior this changes.

## Provider or dependency evidence

- [ ] Upstream identity, official API/package ownership and pinned revision are recorded.
- [ ] LICENSE text and version are linked; copied source/assets, client SDK, server package and hosted service terms are distinguished.
- [ ] Commercial use and network-service obligations are recorded for the intended deployment. Unknown terms are not treated as approval.
- [ ] No private endpoint, credential-bearing URL, proprietary engine, production secret or personal biometric data is included.
- [ ] Catalog state remains candidate/source-reviewed until its actual adapter and operating evidence are approved.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run catalog:check` pass.
- [ ] Server verification, TTL, one-use consumption, context binding and malformed/oversized response behavior are tested.
- [ ] Provider timeout, wrong hostname/action and unsupported assurance fail closed.
- [ ] Browser/assistive-technology results and remaining untested paths are stated separately.
- [ ] Logs and telemetry omit tokens, raw event streams, secrets, IP addresses and raw biometrics.

## Remaining limits

State operating cost, privacy/retention, accessibility fallback, test-vs-production keys, required accounts and unverified claims. A maintainer review or successful test is not an independent deployment/security audit.
